Behind the side doors, colorful abstract small frozen-food packages with no readable words. Spacious cracked grey supermarket tile floor occupies lower half and remains unobstructed for a composited fighting character. No text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, card frame or watermark. Keep center and left foreground clear with a level combat plane. One fixed backdrop for every animation frame.
